description: Films with a replacement cost equal to 20.99 are included along with those above it.

d.request: For each film rating, calculate the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration among films where replacement_cost >= 20.99, then compute the simple mean of these per-rating averages, and display each rating whose average strictly exceeds the overall mean along with its average and the excess above the overall mean (all unrounded).
d.sql: WITH rated_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_value FROM rated_averages) SELECT rated_averages.rating, rated_averages.avg_ratio, rated_averages.avg_ratio - overall_mean.mean_value AS excess FROM rated_averages, overall_mean WHERE rated_averages.avg_ratio > overall_mean.mean_value ORDER BY rated_averages.rating

b.request: Filter films with replacement_cost >= 20.99; for each MPAA rating, compute the mean of (rental_rate / rental_duration) excluding nulls; then compute the mean of these per-rating means (excluding ratings with no valid data); list each rating whose mean strictly exceeds the overall mean, showing the rating, its mean, and its excess above the overall mean, all unrounded.
b.sql: WITH per_rating_means AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS mean_per_rating FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(mean_per_rating) AS overall_avg FROM per_rating_means) SELECT prm.rating, prm.mean_per_rating, prm.mean_per_rating - om.overall_avg AS excess FROM per_rating_means prm CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE prm.mean_per_rating > om.overall_avg ORDER BY prm.rating
b.raw: Filter films with replacement_cost >= 20.99; for each MPAA rating, compute the mean of (rental_rate / rental_duration) excluding nulls; then compute the mean of these per-rating means (excluding ratings with no valid data); list each rating whose mean strictly exceeds the overall mean, showing the rating, its mean, and its excess above the overall mean, all unrounded.

c.request: Using 20.99 as the replacement-cost cutoff for films, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` over the qualifying films (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded). Films with a replacement cost equal to 20.99 are included along with those above it.
c.sql: WITH film_filtered AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_ratio FROM film_filtered GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_value FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_ratio as average, ra.avg_ratio - om.mean_value as above_mean FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ra.avg_ratio > om.mean_value ORDER BY ra.rating

a.request: Among films whose replacement cost is at least 20.99, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded).
a.sql:
WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_rate,
    rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.rating,
  ra.avg_ratio,
  ra.avg_ratio - om.overall_avg AS above_mean
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ra.avg_ratio > om.overall_avg
ORDER BY ra.rating
